risk_flags.description: The contract adds reliance on python-dateutil but explicitly avoids declaring that dependency. That can make the change pass locally while failing in a clean install, CI job, or another developer environment.
risk_flags.span: No requirements file or pyproject.toml will be created/updated

risk_flags.description: The contract says richer ambiguous formats will be accepted, but it does not define how ambiguous numeric dates should be interpreted. This matters because dateutil defaults may silently choose an interpretation the requester does not intend.

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is accepting an undeclared runtime dependency on python-dateutil.
